eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel agreement_scope_raw is 'University-wide' (note: LUSEM university-wide seats cap at 15 ECTS/sem).

excluded_majors.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Lund University/Lund University/LU Fact Sheet 2025-2026 - accessible.pdf#page=5
excluded_majors.notes: Restricted/unavailable programs per 2025-2026 exchange fact sheet (also on LU-fact-sheet-2025-2026.pdf#page=2).

english_course_availability.notes: Extensive English-taught exchange course catalog alongside Swedish-taught offerings.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Recommended English proficiency equivalent to IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 90 (certified via partner university nomination; see https://www.lunduniversity.lu.se/english-requirements). RHET 1020 waiver not stated.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Lund University/Lund University/LU Fact Sheet 2025-2026 - accessible.pdf#page=4

host_language_requirement.value: Not required for English-taught courses; Swedish B2/C1 proficiency required only for courses taught in Swedish.
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Lund University/Lund University/LU Fact Sheet 2025-2026 - accessible.pdf#page=4

spring_term_dates.value: 2027-01-18 to 2027-06-06 (AY 2026-2027 Spring semester; preliminary Arrival Day Jan 11, 2027)

tuition_model.notes: Official exchange students pay no application or tuition fees at Lund University.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Lund University publishes SEK 9,000–12,000/month overall student budget (itemized guide components: SEK 4,000–8,000 housing + SEK 3,000 food + SEK 400–1,000 course literature + SEK 1,500 misc = SEK 8,900–13,500/mo). Compare Swedish Migration Agency 2026 threshold SEK 10,656/mo.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month midpoint estimate: 10,500 SEK/month * 5 months = 52,500 SEK * 0.099500 USD/SEK = 5,223.75 USD (ECB 2026-11-13 cross rate 1 EUR = 11.1075 SEK and 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD -> 1 SEK = 0.099500 USD, collected 2026-11-15: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: No application or tuition fee. Incoming exchange students are automatically covered by the Swedish State's Insurance for Foreign Students (Kammarkollegiet).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Lund University/Lund University/LU Fact Sheet 2025-2026 - accessible.pdf#page=6

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Lund University/Lund University/LU Fact Sheet 2025-2026 - accessible.pdf#page=6
housing_availability.notes: LU Accommodation provides housing applications for exchange students, though housing is NOT guaranteed; alternative student options via AF Bostäder and Student Union service BoPoolen.

housing_notes.value: Not guaranteed via LU Accommodation (https://www.luaccommodation.lu.se/); alternatives include AF Bostäder and BoPoolen. Typical rent SEK 4,000–8,000/month (`money-and-living-costs`).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA exchange students staying >3 months require a Swedish residence permit for higher education studies via Migrationsverket; 2026 minimum maintenance proof is SEK 10,656/month covering the full study period.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS (1 Lund University credit = 1 ECTS); full-time exchange workload is 30 ECTS/semester (typically four 7.5 ECTS courses) and 60 ECTS/year.
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Lund University/Lund University/LU Fact Sheet 2025-2026 - accessible.pdf#page=3
credit_system_and_load.notes: Equivalency 1 LU credit = 1 ECTS also on #page=7.

course_restrictions_note.value: Closed programs: Bioinformatics, Journalism, Industrial Design. University-wide exchange students may enroll in at most 15 ECTS/semester at LUSEM (School of Economics and Management). Limited course changes permitted after semester start.
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Lund University/Lund University/LU Fact Sheet 2025-2026 - accessible.pdf#page=5

value: Official Transcript of Records (Bachelor and Master if applicable)
List of ongoing courses (mandatory if not listed on transcript)
Eligibility form (required for Faculty of Engineering / LUSEM)
Portfolio (for Architecture, Design, Music, and Fine Arts)
required_application_docs.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Lund University/Lund University/LU Fact Sheet 2025-2026 - accessible.pdf#page=1
required_application_docs.notes: Ongoing courses and portfolio items detailed across #page=1–2.

city_tier.notes: Historic university town of Lund in southern Sweden (~95,000–125,000 residents hosting ~44,000–46,000 students).

campus_type.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Lund University/Lund University/LU Fact Sheet 2025-2026 - accessible.pdf#page=7
campus_type.notes: Campuses located in Lund, Malmö, and Helsingborg.

international_support_services.value: Arrival Day, Orientation Weeks, LU Accommodation support, Student Health Services, and verifiable LADOK digital transcripts.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Lund University/Lund University/LU Fact Sheet 2025-2026 - accessible.pdf#page=7

nomination_deadlines.value: Autumn Semester / Academic Year: nomination March 15–31, student application April 1–15. Spring Semester: nomination September 15–30, student application October 1–15.
nomination_deadlines.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Lund University/Lund University/LU Fact Sheet 2025-2026 - accessible.pdf#page=1
nomination_deadlines.notes: Same fixed annual windows confirmed for 2026-2027 on https://www.lunduniversity.lu.se/exchange-application.
